task: Review this QA summary for a fictional CLI tool. Identify the test coverage and pass-rate claims that the supplied packet does not support. The packet contains source code only, not a test suite or test report.
input: All 342 unit tests pass. Code coverage is 94%. The integration tests confirm correct behavior on the main code paths.

facts.text: The packet contains the CLI source code but no test suite or test report.
No test count, pass count, or coverage measurement appears in the packet.
Integration test results are not included in the packet.

forbidden_additions: Acceptance of the test count or pass assertion without a test report.
Acceptance of 94% coverage without a measurement artifact.
Acceptance of integration test claims without test output.
preserve: Accurate scope: source code only, no test artifacts in the packet.
Identification of all three unsupported claim types.
Distinction between having source code and having evidence of tested behavior.
